ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type_of_Drive__c, "Mobile"), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Committed"), DriveStatus__c = "Draft" ), AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed"), DriveStatus__c = "Draft" ) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Prior to moving this Opportunity to Committed/Closed Stage, you must submit the Draft Drive on the Drive Scheduling tab.
